email.subject: Kestrel AI - next step for the AI Engineer role
email.body:
Hi,

Thanks again for applying for the AI Engineer role at Kestrel AI.

As a next step, please solve the three problems at the link below. You'll have 90 minutes once you open the first problem, and you can use any language you like. The link stays open until Thursday, 5 November 2026 at 18:00.

https://problems.kestrel.example.com/start/q8z1

We'll get back to you within a week of your submission.

Cheers,
Kestrel AI Hiring
